title: More options for chat and images
summary:
New chat and image options, a way to keep text requests off the public feed, and a browser-based coding assistant joined the garden.

Hormoz 8B was added for chat with temperature and JSON-mode support. The turbo image model was enabled with prompt enhancement and a maximum side length of 768 pixels.

Text requests can now set `private=true` to keep responses out of the public feed, and the model list adds `deepseek-reasoner`. OpenAI-style responses also get consistent `pllns_` IDs and choice indexes.

ElliotEtag added the browser-based pollinations.diy coding assistant to the monorepo, with AI chat, an editor, terminal, preview, and project import. The project lists also gained @brain.diver’s MIDI melody generator PolliSonic and withthatway’s multi-model chatbot urSapere AI.

highlights.title: Hormoz 8B joins chat
highlights.text: Chat with Hormoz 8B using temperature controls or JSON mode. [Browse Hormoz 8B](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=hormoz).

highlights.title: Turbo image generation
highlights.text: Generate images with the turbo model, including prompt enhancement and a maximum side length of 768 pixels. [Browse turbo](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=turbo).

highlights.title: DeepSeek R1 Full added
highlights.text: The text model list now includes `deepseek-reasoner` (DeepSeek R1 - Full). [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek-reasoner).

highlights.title: Keep text off the feed
highlights.text: Set `private=true` in a text request’s GET query or POST body to skip broadcasting its response to the public feed. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Coding in the browser
highlights.text: The pollinations.diy coding assistant was added to the monorepo, bringing AI chat alongside a code editor, terminal, project preview, and Git or local-folder import.
